messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: error-rate spike detected on inference-gateway (gateway-prod)
incident-bot: Summary: 10m p95 latency from 120ms -> 2.3s, p99 from 450ms -> 8.6s, 5xx rate up 4.7% (baseline ~0.1%).
elena: seeing the same in dashboards — traces point at `gateway-proxy` pools 3 & 4.
chris: recent deploy 4387650000 to routing logic? deploy-bot: Deployed by chris at 4387650000 (commit: f3a2b9)
mike: yep that rollout included a small change to connection keepalive and multiplexing heuristics. rolling back now?
elena: can we verify whether KV cache evictions started spiking after the deploy? logs show `kvcache.evictions` increased ~x20
chris: `kubectl get pods -l svc=gateway-proxy -o wide` shows restarts on pool-4, OOMKill? grabbing logs...
onsite-sre: I have a heatmap of request falloff — tail latency exploded for payloads > 2k tokens. Possibly batching interaction with keepalive change.
chris: pushing rollback of routing-change (revert f3a2b9) to canary and then to production. initiating at 4387654350.
elena: runbook says immediate rollback if p99 > 5s and 5xx > 1% for >5m. we're currently at p99 8.6s and 5xx 4.7% for ~7m. qualifies.
chris: rollback started -> `kubectl apply -f revert-routing.yaml`
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by chris at 4387654360, target: gateway-proxy pools 3-4.
mike: while rollback runs, can someone flip autoscale to hard cap and enable fallback policy to model-variant small? we should shed load gracefully.
nisha: enabling fallback route now: `rbac update route=legacy-small priority=high` — waiting for propagation.
elena: toggled prefix/KV cache snapshot restore on pool-3 to reduce cold misses.
onsite-sre: watch: 1m after rollback started p95 improved from 2.3s -> 950ms but p99 still high at ~4.2s. 5xx rate dropping but still elevated.
chris: rollback complete on pool-3 at 4387654460, pool-4 still draining.
onsite-sre: pool-4 drained at 4387654500; overall p95 now 420ms, p99 720ms, 5xx down to 0.3%.
mike: can we confirm customer impact scope? any active sessions dropped?
elena: preliminary: spike affected ~0.6% of requests as 5xx, concentrated on long context calls (>2k tokens) and multiplexed connections. Some partner customers reported request timeouts; no wide data corruption reported.
nisha: notified account-engagement for customers with active SLAs. created RFC ticket INC-2026 for postmortem.
chris: oncall handoff: I'll stay for the next 30m to validate telemetry. @onsite-sre do you want the formal handoff?
onsite-sre: I'll take over the watch. dropping a summary in #incidents-summary.
elena: notes for postmortem: reproduce with stress rig calling gateway-proxy with payloads 2500-4000 tokens under multiplexing and keepalive toggles. include KV cache eviction traces.
mike: followups: add additional canary gating that tests tail latency for long-context requests; add synthetic tests for p99 under multiplexing enabled.
chris: kudos for quick rollback. logging action items to INC-2026.
elena: tagging: deploy, kvcache, gateway, perf, canary.
incident-bot: Incident resolved by rollback at 4387654500. Severity: Sev2. Pager cleared.
nisha: pushing brief to customers affected; will coordinate postmortem and mitigation timeline. :thumbsup:
